intro: By reading about a custom, he observes who practices it, in what situation and with what variation; he avoids generalizing an entire society.

bloques.titulo: By reading about a custom, he observes who practices it, in what situation and with what variation; he avoids generalizing an entire society.
texto: By reading about a custom, he observes who practices it, in what situation and with what variation; he avoids generalizing an entire society.
A local or historical source can describe a specific practice, not a universal rule over each person.

frases.ru: В некоторых семьях праздник отмечают дома, а в других — в ресторане.
frases.es: Algunas familias celebran la fiesta en casa y otras en un restaurante.
frases.en: Some families celebrate the party at home and others at a restaurant.

frases.ru: Авторы подчёркивают, что привычки меняются в зависимости от региона и поколения.
frases.es: Los autores subrayan que las costumbres varían según la región y la generación.
frases.en: The authors stress that customs vary by region and generation.

bloques.pregunta: What limit do the authors point to?
